force_model: full first-order post-Newtonian interactions through REBOUNDx gr_full
vector constant-time-lag tide and coupled Earth spin through REBOUNDx tides_spin

one_year_j2_isolation.comparison: full model minus an otherwise identical earth_j2_enabled=false run

newtonian_energy_diagnostic.interpretation: This is not a total conserved-energy error: it omits the J2 and 1PN Hamiltonian terms, and the tide is dissipative.

limitations: The constant-time-lag tide is calibrated to the present real-Moon recession rate; it is not a frequency-dependent ocean or solid-Earth tide model.
The moons are point masses for tidal response; tides, deformation, and spin inside either moon are omitted.
Earth's J2 axis is fixed in ICRF and its reaction torque on Earth spin is omitted.
Skyfield's observed Earth orientation is retained as the reference and the modeled differential spin phase and pole are composed onto it.
